title: Installation Part Returned on Trial Refunds — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Installation part returned on a trial refund — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** The trial refund is figured from the set's warranty ledger: the installation part it returns depends on the workmanship replacement entries of the set, and on how soon the set came back.

| Set at return | Installation part returned |
|---|---|
| carries a workmanship replacement entry | the tire count times the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire |
| no workmanship replacement entry, returned within half of the line's trial days (days kept, from the install date, at most half) | half of the tire count times the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire |
| any other set | the installation part as the line sets it: the full tire count times the mount-and-balance charge where the line returns installation with the tires, 0 where it does not |

Half of the trial days by line, in line order: 15, 15, 22.5, 22.5, 30, 30 days (of 30, 30, 45, 45, 60, 60).

**Both sides (hypothetical 4-tire set on a 45-day line, $25.00 mounting, line not returning installation):** returned on day 22, no workmanship entry — $50.00; day 23 — $0.00; any day with a workmanship replacement entry — $100.00.
